{
  "categories": [

      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled IPC; introduces `interfaces::Snapshot` in `src/interfaces/snapshot.h` and adds snapshot loading methods to `interfaces::Node`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes assumeutxo snapshot loading through the node interface abstraction to allow GUI and multiprocess consumers to load snapshots and receive progress notifications. It directly unblocks downstream GUI implementations in bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extends the kernel notifications boundary in `src/kernel/notifications_interface.h` to emit snapshot loading progress updates.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds progress notification signals to `kernel::Notifications` to surface assumeutxo coin population progress to kernel API consumers. The change extends the notification interface cleanly without modifying core kernel validation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matched paths only via `src/validation.cpp`; no mempool or transaction relay policy changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch mempool data structures, limits, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Refactors `loadtxoutset` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to delegate to `interfaces::Snapshot`, altering failure error codes.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.20,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Refactors `loadtxoutset` to consume the new snapshot interface rather than calling internal chainstate helpers directly. This alters failure error codes from `RPC_INVALID_PARAMETER` and `RPC_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR` to `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR`, but is otherwise a secondary consumer update."
    },

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively alter consensus rules, chainstate invariants, or validation performance."
    }
